title: Moon 3D Models for Web, AR, and Animation
colorMap: From NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit (SVS 4720), centred on 0° longitude, as stated on the SVS 14959 page
license: Not stated on the SVS 14959 page. NASA media are generally not copyrighted; follow NASA's media usage guidelines and keep the credit line.

derivation.change: Colour map re-encoded from 4096x4096 PNG to 2048x2048 JPEG (quality 90) to fit the Quest texture budget (AGENTS.md section 6). Geometry, UVs and material are NASA's, copied byte for byte.

geometry.modelUnits: Not stated by the source. The app scales the globe to a display size and never reads lunar distances from it.
geometry.orientation: +Y is lunar north; the near side (0° N, 0° E) faces -Z; +90° E faces -X. Determined by the NEXUS team by rendering the model from each axis and matching the near-side maria, Tycho and Mare Orientale; it is not stated by the source.
geometry.knownLimits: Flat colour sphere: no topography. The SVS page notes pinched poles on its grid and topo variants.

coordinateReferenceSystem: Not stated by the source. Lat/lon placement on the globe uses the orientation above with planetocentric coordinates; it is approximate at globe scale and not for measurement.
